title: Increase Muon matrix learning rate
description: Increased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 (+25%) to address 15x imbalance with embedding LR
reflection: Result: val_bpb 0.996553 (tied baseline, no improvement). All three agents independently converged on this idea, yet it yields no gain. Confirms tight local optimum: single-parameter tweaks consistently fail or tie. The baseline 0.04 for MATRIX_LR is already well-calibrated despite the apparent imbalance. 944 steps executed successfully with 39.4% MFU. Single hyperparameter changes remain exhausted; architectural modifications or multi-parameter coordination needed to escape local optimum.
